title: Wonderful experience
text: We had a great time, our guide Isabel was very knowledgeable and very friendly. We would take this tour again with her as our guide. Highly recommended.
author: Shaun_H

title: Old Town - Informative Stroll.
text: The 2 churches & El Born district were the hi-lites. Gaby our guide was pleasant, interesting and informative.
author: SimonPeter_K

title: Lenise was absolutely...
text: Lenise was absolutely EXCEPTIONAL as a guide. She was unbelievably knowledgeable, but had a wonderful conversational style that made us feel engaged in a conversation about Barcelona. She was charming and passionate and able to keep three generations interested ...it was worth every minute. Thank you Lenise.
author: Lisa_D

title: Great tour in gothic quarter
text: Our guide was great and we learned alot. I would do it again and recommend to anyone coming to Barcelona
author: Cliff_R

title: Very informative tour.
text: Xavi was the tour guide and he managed to show us almost all interesting places in the Old Town and the Jewish Quarter. We met smoothly at the accepted meeting point and had a wonderful experience together. We learned a lot also. This tour should not be missed.
author: Axel P

title: Visit of Gothic and Roman Barcelona
text: Very informative and interesting visit. Roger, our friendly guide, offered us a discovery of Barcelona through the great moments of its history. Always listening to us, he answered our many questions. I strongly recommend this visit to people who want to discover Barcelona and its history in a minimum of time.
author: Emmanuelle M

title: Great interesting Tour with a lovely guide
text: We had the chance to be only me and my daughter for that tour, so we had our guide Jorge just for us, adapting the tour on our interest. We saw  a lot of nice places with great explanations. Jorge was very well prepared, informed us about a lot of things about Spain and some special places in the old town. We really appreciated these nice moments with such a friendly and lovely guide.
author: Charlien707

title: Enjoy a relaxing walk around Barcelona old city
text: Great tour. Enthusiastic and knowledgable guide. A good introduction to Barcelona and helpful in orientating us to plan our next steps. Coffee and pastries were great too
author: garywebb2019

title: Best Real Barcelona Walking Tour
text: Roger did an amazing job sharing and showing us the history and the expansion of Barcelona. He was very knowledgeable and personable.
author: Regina_W

title: Fantastic informative tour of Old Town Barcelona
text: Xavi was a wonderful tour guide, going at our pace. He was very knowledgeable and super friendly. He was at our hotel on time. We enjoyed this tour immensely. I would give it ☀️☀️☀️☀️☀️!!!
author: Exploration790621
